note: Regions of db.query(region=...) (anta_database/regions.py): the ice sheets and IMBIE basins (polygons of ANT_Basins_IMBIE2_v1.6.parquet), short names of places, and every place of the SCAR Composite Gazetteer of Antarctica (scar_gazetteer.parquet). Names and aliases are matched without case or accents. The short names of the basins are a draft, to check against Rignot et al. (2019) and Mouginot et al. (2017).

sources.IMBIE: IMBIE2 drainage basins, v1.6 (Rignot et al.; Mouginot et al., 2017)
sources.SCAR: SCAR Composite Gazetteer of Antarctica, Australian Antarctic Data Centre, https://data.aad.gov.au/aadc/gaz/scar/ (CC BY 4.0)

QML.name: Queen Mary Land, Wilhelm II Land (Denman, Shackleton)

TAM.name: Transantarctic Mountains outlets to the Ross Ice Shelf (Byrd, Beardmore)

FIS.name: Filchner Ice Shelf (Recovery, Support Force, Foundation)

PL.name: Palmer Land, George VI Ice Shelf

LIS.name: Larsen Ice Shelf side of the Peninsula

place radius km.note: A place is the point of the gazetteer, or of the ice core where one is given (the points of the gazetteer for Dome C and Talos Dome are 45-50 km from the summits). A line is at a place when it passes within this distance of its point, by the feature type of the place; the other types: default. A query can give its own (radius=, in km).
